mechanism.claim: When the completed current one-hour BTC auction expands into its own strict-prior range tail while sharing unusually little price interval with the immediately preceding one-hour auction, the entire accepted-price set has migrated; follow the midpoint displacement for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of current-hour midpoint minus preceding-hour midpoint
mechanism.why_distinct: AARMR uses set intersection of adjacent high-low intervals plus current range expansion. It is not wick/body efficiency, close location, Donchian reclaim, variance ratio, jump size, sign persistence, volume, flow, VWAP, funding, premium, OI, cross-asset breadth, or a prior control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: tail current range plus low adjacent-auction overlap identifies accepted-price migration during volatile discovery; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only false-to-true low-overlap range-migration onsets reserve entries

features.preceding_auction: exact twelve coherent completed five-minute bars [D-2h,D-1h)
features.current_auction: exact twelve coherent completed five-minute bars [D-1h,D)
features.range: H-L for each auction; both strictly positive
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 1440 prior valid hourly decisions, minimum 960, current excluded
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding exact hourly opportunity false; missing prior cannot trigger
features.availability: all bars complete by D; entry one full five-minute bar later
features.source_valid: exact unique timestamp grids, positive finite coherent OHLC, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.range_tail_only: current-range rank>=0.80 onset without overlap gate
definitions.low_overlap_only: overlap-ratio rank<=0.20 onset without range gate
definitions.one_hour_stale_geometry: primary eligibility and side shifted one exact hour before onset

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block predicate, threshold, confirmation, embargo, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
